newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index off 0.94 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index off 0.94 pct.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was off 0.94 percent or 0.65 points after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index finished 13.29 points or 0.43 percent lower at a provisional 3,112.77.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 13.14 percent after 13.40 percent on Wednesday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
